lines.zh: 我贴着水底挪，壳擦着沙。
lines.en: I shift along the bottom, shell scraping the sand.

lines.zh: 我走得很快，几乎看不清。
lines.en: I move fast, almost impossible to follow.

lines.zh: 我一路留下点点的水痕。
lines.en: I leave a trail of wet spots.
I slip through the small channel.

lines.zh: 我贴着岸边走，找落单的。
lines.en: I move along the bank looking for stragglers.
I veer a little your way.

lines.zh: 我一会儿浮上来，一会儿沉下去。
lines.en: I rise and sink by turns.

lines.zh: 我的壳在石头上碰了一下。
lines.en: My shell knocks against a stone.
I go around the leaves floating on the water.
I head toward the village.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条水线往前走。
lines.en: I walk on, dragging a line of water.
I step through the shallows with very little sound.
I turn my shell as I go.
I follow the drain downward.
I am looking for a way without walls.
I pause, then go on.

lines.zh: 我停在石缝里，只露壳口。
lines.en: I stop in a stone gap with only the shell opening showing.
I listen for who walks on the bank.
My tentacles test the water lightly.
I draw in and the shell closes tight.
The fish here keep away from me.
I lie in the shallows counting breaths.
There are old cracks in my shell.
I ease out an inch.

lines.zh: 水面上的光晃得我看不清。
lines.en: The light on the water blurs my sight.

lines.zh: 我没有声响，几乎像块石头。
lines.en: I make no sound, almost like a stone.
I keep to the bank without moving.
I keep here and wait for night.

lines.zh: 我在数岸边走过的人数。
lines.en: I am counting those who pass on the bank.
I raise my head and look a while.

lines.zh: 我从壳口看你，只露一点点。
lines.en: I watch you from the shell opening, barely showing.
You are on the bank; I am in the water.
Half an eye emerges from my shell.
You have no shell.
My tentacles reach toward you.
You step back, and I stop.

lines.zh: 我在水里跟着你的影子。
lines.en: I follow your shadow from the water.
There is no one with you.
I press low against the sand.
Your feet are very close to the water.
I pull into my shell and roll half a turn.
Another crack in my shell.
I slide off a little.
I draw in very tight.
That was no light blow.

lines.zh: 我从壳里探出来看了一眼。
lines.en: I poke out of the shell for a look.
I retreat with the water.
I shake my shell.
The one in the water has stirred.
I did not dare come closer.
That is not what I want.
That is not enough to eat.

lines.zh: 你把食物举在水边，方便我。
lines.en: Holding food at the water's edge suits me.
This bait is too plain for me.
I turn my head and move off.
That smell is very faint.
That will not draw me.
I looked only once.

lines.zh: 举这么高，我的触须够不到。
lines.en: Held that high, my tendrils can't reach.
That bait is too obvious.
You hit me and I pull into my shell.
The shell is hard; your foot will hurt.
I slide away with the water.
I back half a foot, shell opening toward you.
That knocked my shell with a clack.
I slip past the edge of your boot.
I surface again, closer.
Do not tread on me when you step.
You kick and I roll away.

lines.zh: 这点力气，对我来说不小。
lines.en: That much force is not small to me.

lines.zh: 我们产卵在水里就够了。
lines.en: Laying eggs in the water is enough for us.
There is no such thing between us.
I have left a string of eggs.
That is not what concerns me.
I sank straight down.
There will be more in the water on their own.
I find the spawning ground myself.
My part is only to lay the eggs.
I do not follow that part.
I drew back into my shell.
I catch it with my tentacles.

lines.zh: 我把它埋进沙里，看不见了。
lines.en: I bury it in sand; it vanishes.
It slipped away at a touch.
Too hard to bite; I push it.
I will not so much as touch this.
I tuck it under my shell.
I roll it back into the water.
Too small to hold.
I simply let it drop.
This one has a taste to it.
I burst out of the water.
I have you, and close.
I mark you, shell mouth forward.
Shell opening toward you, I ready a ram.
There is no wall to shield you.

lines.zh: 我低低地贴着地面过来。
lines.en: I come in low along the ground.

lines.zh: 我的触须一下全伸开了。
lines.en: All my tentacles snap open.
I have chosen you, now.

lines.zh: 我在这些人里挑中了你。
lines.en: Out of all of them, I picked you.
I rise some way up.
I stay pressed close, following.
You turn and I turn with you.
I circle your ankles.
The one in the water follows too.
I never leave your legs.
You cannot step on me; I am too quick.
I crowd you toward the water.
My shell opening flexes open and shut.
One step closer is enough.

lines.zh: 我贴着石头绕，你也拦不住。
lines.en: I slip around the stones; you cannot stop it.
I ram your ankle.
My tentacles wrap your calf.
The shell closes, and that is a bite.
Tendrils retract; I slide back into the water.
That bite carries venom.

lines.zh: 你踢空了，我钻到另一边。
lines.en: You kick air; I am at the other side.

lines.zh: 撞完这一下，我立刻沉底。
lines.en: After the blow I sink at once.
You were a step late again.
I bite down on your heel.
My quickness will annoy you.
A small shell surfaces at the water's edge.
I slide in with the current.

lines.zh: 岸上忽然多了一串湿印。
lines.en: Wet prints suddenly appear on the bank.

lines.zh: 我在水边留下一串湿爪印。
lines.en: I leave a string of wet prints at the water's edge.

lines.zh: 壳口先露出水面，然后是我。
lines.en: First my shell mouth, then the rest of me.
The people here should be afraid of me.
I surface with my shell toward the bank.
I check the depth first.

lines.zh: 水底的气味告诉我有猎物。
lines.en: The bottom's scent tells me prey is near.
I lie still in the shallows.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的壳，我滚进水里。
lines.en: Fire bakes my shell; I roll into the water.

lines.zh: 我摔在石上，壳裂了一道缝。
lines.en: I fall on stone and a seam splits in my shell.

lines.zh: 水灌进壳里，我拼命往外挤。
lines.en: Water floods my shell; I squeeze hard to get out.

lines.zh: 爆风把我卷出去，壳撞在墙上。
lines.en: The blast throws me and my shell hits a wall.
Something punches through the shell's rim.

lines.zh: 一股力把壳口封住了，我挣不开。
lines.en: Something seals my shell opening and I cannot open it.
Hunger makes even retreating slow.

lines.zh: 雷落进水里，我整只都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the water and all of me goes numb.

lines.zh: 没有水，也没有地，我什么也抓不住。
lines.en: No water, no ground, nothing to grip.
